//: The only place a Cauldra frontend build may learn which backend it points at. scripts/build-target-config.js validates every entry and refuses anything not declared here. Adding a target is a tracked, reviewable change.

web.description: Ordinary web deployment served by backend/main.py from frontend/. Same-origin; no override is emitted. This is the target the checked-in frontend/js/build-target.js must match.

qa.description: QA service cauldra-qa. The only target permitted for QA/audit Android builds.

production.description: Canonical production address. Custom domain for Railway service supply-ai-demo, whose underlying service URL is https://cauldra.up.railway.app (infrastructure only; never a build target). Shipping Android releases only. Must equal NATIVE_PRODUCTION_API_BASE_URL in frontend/js/app.js; verify-native-bundle.js fails the build otherwise.
